title: Erlang Factory SF 2016 Keynote  Phoenix and Elm – Making the Web Functional
summary: A joint Erlang Factory 2016 keynote by Phoenix creator Chris McCord and Elm creator Evan Czaplicki on using the two together, including Phoenix.Presence design and PubSub optimizations.
why: Pointed to as the best source on Phoenix Presence internals and for combining Phoenix with Elm.

quote.text: My Erlang Factory keynote also goes into the design considerations and PubSub layer optimizations that sits underneath Phoenix.Presence
